title: Grype (Anchore, Apache-2.0): the JSON report the customer's pipeline writes
readScopes: None for the collector: it reads the report file. Grype runs in the customer's pipeline (`grype <image|dir|sbom> -o json --file <file>`).

checks.title: No critical or high vulnerability whose fix has been available longer than the allowed days
checks.scope: Packages in the scanned image, directory or SBOM; the fix date is the vulnerability feed's, not when the customer learned of it.
